policy: ADR-018 (docs/decisions.md): a profile value is changed only when at least two independent publishers read directly agree on the new value within the research methodology's agreement tolerances and every directly read source supporting the old value is of a strictly lower tier than both of them; otherwise the record says kept or disputed and why (app.services.research.decisions.propose). Model wind never decides. Sensitivity numbers: scripts/profile_sensitivity.py decisions --run-id 4 on the real 2026-10-11 runs (database swell_live2, read-only).
